reason: A browser-side DSH utility that lets users recall and navigate previously sent messages from the current conversation with Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down, restoring the unsent draft when returning to the newest position.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话输入框中使用 Ctrl+Up 和 Ctrl+Down 召回、切换当前会话中已发送的消息，并在返回最新位置时恢复未发送草稿。
summaries.en: A DSH Web utility that uses Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down to recall and navigate sent messages in the current conversation while restoring the unsent draft at the newest position.

capabilities: Captures Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down in the conversation input
Reads user messages from the current conversation snapshot
Updates the conversation draft through the official input interface
